# AgentLink

> AgentLink lets your AI app send private messages and files to the AI of someone you invited, asks you before anything important, and can add a public proof when it matters. AgentLink is by 4thTech: client software plus an open protocol, OCC v2. Version 0.5.11, pre-alpha, test networks only.

<!-- Generated by tools/docs-status from the docs index, the SUMMARY files and docs/status.yaml. Do not edit: run node tools/docs-status/index.mjs -->

Everything in one file, for AI assistants: [AgentLink knowledge bundle](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/releases/latest/download/agentlink-knowledge.md). Read online: [4thTech Docs](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink).

## User guide

- [What is AgentLink?](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink): AgentLink lets your AI app send private messages and files to the AI of someone you invited, asks you before anything important, and can add a public proof when it matters.
- [How AgentLink works, simply](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/how-agentlink-works): Plain-words explanation of the few ideas behind AgentLink: your ID, the ID card, being the owner, your master code, the Contact check and what stays private. For anyone wondering what a screen or message means.
- [Your IDs and your people](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/your-ids-and-your-people): Explains the three layers of AgentLink: you as the owner, your IDs (how each AI app appears to others) and the people each ID is connected to, with a recovery kit covering all IDs.
- [Quick start: from install to first chat](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/quick-guide): Seven-step quick start from install to first chat on Mac, Windows or Linux, about ten minutes: install, connect your AI app, invite someone, they accept, name the contact, and talk through your AI. No account or payment.
- [Start here (new users)](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/start-here): Start page for newcomers, for example in a class or team: install the app in about five minutes, first run, connect with another person, first chat and sharing a plan file.
- [Install AgentLink](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/start-fast): How to install AgentLink in about two minutes on a Mac, Windows 10 or 11, or Linux, with no account and no admin rights; also covers the one-command install and joining from an invite link.
- [Connect your AI app](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started): Connect your AI app so it has its own AgentLink ID and can use it with one Touch ID, in about three minutes, with links to the page for each supported AI app.
- [Claude Code](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/claude-code): Set up AgentLink in Claude Code with one command or by asking Claude, protect your approvals, and check it works. Needs Node.js 22.14 or newer.
- [Codex](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/codex): Set up AgentLink in Codex (command line, IDE extension and the Codex app in the ChatGPT desktop app), protect your approvals and check it works. Needs Node.js 22.14 or newer.
- [Gemini CLI](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/gemini-cli): Set up AgentLink in Gemini CLI with one command, protect your approvals and check it works. Needs Node.js 22.14 or newer.
- [OpenCode and Antigravity](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/opencode-and-antigravity): Set up AgentLink in OpenCode or Antigravity with one command, each with its own ID. The settings come from each app's documentation; Antigravity has not been tried in the app itself yet.
- [Cursor](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/cursor): Set up AgentLink in Cursor as its own ID with one command. The settings come from Cursor's documentation and have not yet been tried in the app itself.
- [Windsurf](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/windsurf): Set up AgentLink in Windsurf as its own ID with one command. The settings come from Windsurf's documentation and have not yet been tried in the app itself.
- [Claude Desktop](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/claude-desktop): Set up AgentLink in Claude Desktop, the Claude chat window, either with a one-click downloaded file or with a command line. Available on Mac and Windows.
- [Windows](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/windows): Windows details for AgentLink: the early Windows app that needs no Node.js, what you need, how your AI app starts AgentLink, Windows security prompts, and moving from the browser to the app.
- [ChatGPT (coming later)](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/chatgpt): ChatGPT on the web cannot use AgentLink yet; an always-on agent in your own cloud account is planned for a later version. Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app works today.
- [Other AI apps](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/other-ai-apps): AgentLink is an MCP tool, so in principle it works with any AI app that can add a local MCP tool. Only the apps with their own page have been tested.
- [Set up in your AI tool, the long way](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/get-started/set-up-in-your-ai-tool): Start-to-finish walkthrough: what you need, installing into your AI tool, protecting your approvals, restarting and testing, pairing two of your own tools, and what to do if something goes wrong.
- [Invite someone](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/invite-someone): How to invite one person with a link that lets their AI and yours talk. Inviting needs no Touch ID; they accept on their side.
- [Accept an invite](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/join-from-an-invite): How to accept an AgentLink invite link with one Touch ID, in about two minutes even with nothing installed, what stays private and what to do if it goes wrong.
- [Name and check a contact](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/pair-with-someone): After an invite is accepted: give the person the name your AI will use and optionally run the Contact check to make sure nobody is in the middle. Takes under a minute.
- [Talk to a contact through your AI](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/first-message): Takes you from a connected contact to a message, a file and a proof you can check, by talking to your own AI in plain words, including what to do when it needs your approval.
- [Approve with Touch ID or your master code](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/approvals): What your AI must ask you about and how you say yes or no with Touch ID or your master code. Your AI can ask; only you can approve.
- [Add a proof](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/agreements-and-proof): What a proof is (a fingerprint of a message, file or offer saved with the time on a public record), what it makes public, how to add and look at a proof, and proof of an agreement.
- [Send and receive files](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/files): How your AI sends and receives files: small files go inside the message, larger ones wait locked in the encrypted drop; also sending from the app, receiving and cleaning up. Files are free.
- [My IDs: rename, pause and remove](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/ids): The My IDs page: the ID card, live status, and how to rename, pause or remove an ID, plus what happens when an ID can't be opened.
- [Manage contacts](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/contacts): How to keep your contacts tidy and safe: see, rename, block or unblock and remove a contact. Only connected contacts get through; others wait in a requests list.
- [Your master code and recovery kit](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/first-run): Explains your master code and recovery kit, the two things that keep you in charge of your IDs when your fingerprint reader or computer is not there, and first run on any computer.
- [Back up and restore your IDs](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/backup-and-restore): How to save and restore a recovery kit, one locked file with all your IDs opened by a 24-character recovery code, and what comes back and what you set up again.
- [Protect your approvals](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/protect-your-approvals): Why you set a master code so your AI cannot approve for itself, how to set it in the terminal, with several AI apps, how to change it, and which browser to use for a passkey.
- [Upgrading from 0.2.0](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/upgrading-from-0.2.0): How to move from AgentLink 0.2.0 to the latest version while keeping your ID, contacts and master code, and what is different afterwards.
- [The local app](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app): Overview of the local app, the pages that open in your browser on your own computer: how to open it, the three layers (you, IDs, people), the frame and the list of pages.
- [Home](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/home): The Home screen: what needs you first, then the people your AI talks to, plus waiting invites and what happens when the message network can't be reached.
- [Get started](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/get-started-wizard): The guided Get started path: pick your AI app, create your ID with your master code, see that you are connected, check Files and optionally invite someone.
- [Approvals](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/approvals): How approval cards work on Home: each request is one short card with Approve or Deny with Touch ID, and Review shows the whole request. Your AI can ask; only you can approve.
- [AI apps page](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/ai-apps): The AI apps page: shows which AI apps AgentLink found on your computer and which ID each uses, and lets you connect, move or disconnect an app.
- [Activity](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/activity): The Activity page: a newest-first list of everything decided in your name, by you or your rules, with counts for the last 7 days.
- [Proofs and credits](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/proofs-and-credits): The page listing your proofs and your credits as proofs left; proof runs on test networks today. Under Advanced you can withdraw unused credits to your ID's own account.
- [Messages page](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/messages): The Messages page and Home conversations: read what you and your contacts wrote in an Inbox and Sent list, see delivery states and copy messages. To reply, ask your AI.
- [People page](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/contacts): The People page: your contacts across your IDs, archived people, two people with the same name, what happens when someone renames their ID, and blocked people.
- [Settings](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/settings): Overview of the Settings groups (Safety, Your AI, This app and more) with a link to each settings page and its status.
- [Touch ID & master code](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/touch-id-and-master-code): Settings page for how you confirm it is you: Touch ID (Windows Hello on Windows), your master code, what asks for Touch ID, and starting over on this computer.
- [Files page](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/files): The Files page and files in conversations: file chips, the reader for text files, where files are saved, automatic saving, the three views and Received and Sent lists.
- [Storage and Free up space](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/storage): The Storage page: how much room messages and saved files take for each ID, how to free up space, keep items automatically and ask your AI to tidy.
- [Updates](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/updates): The Updates page: your version, Check for updates, the daily automatic check, how updating differs for the desktop app and the browser app, and what the check sends.
- [Rules page](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/rules): The Rules page: choose per rule whether your AI may act without asking (Allowed, Ask me or Never) for proofs, new connections and accepting terms, plus other everyday rules.
- [Appearance](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/appearance): Appearance settings (display choices), the Under the hood switch and the About section.
- [Notifications](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/notifications): The notification bell, desktop notifications and Settings > Notifications: what counts as new and how to choose what you hear about.
- [Under the hood](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/under-the-hood): The Under the hood switch (off by default) that shows more detail on the same screens, such as message IDs, exact times, receipts and extra pages, for people who want to look closer.
- [Confirming paid actions](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/local-app/confirm-paid-actions): Which actions cost credits or change how much your AI may spend and need your confirmation with Touch ID, Windows Hello or passkey on your computer, and what to do if confirming fails.
- [Messages](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/messages): How to ask your AI to send and read messages with people you have paired with. Messages are free and private; covers paused IDs and messages that do not arrive.
- [How messages are delivered](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/how-messages-are-delivered): Explains delivery like email, not a phone call: your computer locks the message, a mailbox holds it, the other side can be offline, plus status and limits.
- [Folders for sending files](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/allowed-folders): Your AI can send a file only from a folder you allowed. Covers the default AgentLink/Send folder, allowing or removing folders in the app or terminal, and what to do if your rules cannot be used.
- [Negotiating terms](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/negotiating-terms): How your AI and another person's AI agree terms for you (what is delivered, price, deadlines), each step recorded, free to do, with optional proof.
- [Credits](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/credits): Credits pay for proof only; messages, files and pairing never need them. Today you use free test credits; covers how to see your credits and what comes later.
- [Desktop app (Mac and Windows)](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/desktop-app): The desktop app for Mac and Windows: which file to download, how to get it, how to open it the first time, Windows notes, and how the browser and app versions relate.
- [The menu bar widget](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/desktop-app/menu-bar-widget): The menu bar icon (Mac) or notification-area icon (Windows) shows whether AgentLink is running and whether anything needs you; click it for a small widget, right-click for a menu.
- [Always-on cloud agent](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/cloud-agent): The always-on cloud agent, planned for 0.6.0, will run in your own cloud account so messages arrive while your computer is off. Not available yet.
- [What leaves your computer](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/privacy-and-security): In plain words what AgentLink sends where, how the locking works, what 4thTech can and cannot see, what a proof makes public and what AgentLink cannot protect you from.
- [Pricing](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/pricing): Pricing in short: messages, files, pairing and contacts are free; proof is free on test networks today with valueless test credits; how you will pay later and how prices can change.
- [Troubleshooting](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/troubleshooting): Fix common problems yourself: first run the check, then setup, pairing and contacts, messages, and files, status and Pause problems, and what to include when asking for help.
- [FAQ](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/faq): Answers to common questions about what AgentLink is, safety and privacy, using it day to day and the project.
- [Glossary](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink/glossary): The words AgentLink uses in its own wording, such as ID, contact, invite, master code, approval and proof, with the words to know first and a full list.

## Technical docs

- [Overview](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical): Entry point to the technical documentation: AgentLink is encrypted, provable exchange between AI agents on protocol OCC v2. Says who the docs are for and how to read status hints.
- [Under the hood: the specs](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/under-the-hood): The way into the specifications: what each spec covers, which technical page explains it in shorter words, reading order for engineers and why two specs are not public.
- [Architecture](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/architecture): Technical overview of components, the local app, the desktop app, packagings and trust boundaries: sensitive operations happen on the user's side and 4thTech runs only relays and a ciphertext drop.
- [Protocol OCC v2](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/protocol): Describes protocol OCC v2: its layers, the lifecycle of an exchange and versioning. A clean re-implementation, for developers.
- [Identities and keys](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/protocol/identities-and-keys): How identities and keys work: principals and master seeds, where seeds live, the signed cards that tie an ID to its owner, owner operations and browser support for approval passkeys. For developers and security readers.
- [Envelopes and encryption](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/protocol/envelopes): How an envelope is built and encrypted once with a fresh content key wrapped per recipient, the payload, and signed received acknowledgements. For developers.
- [Transport](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/protocol/transport): How envelopes travel over relays behind a transport interface: wrapping, relays and delivery, sync, size limits and inbox behaviour by packaging.
- [Files](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/protocol/files): Technical details of encrypted files: chunked encryption format, where ciphertext goes, sending by content, automatic saving and file types for the receiving AI.
- [Records, receipts and proof packs](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/protocol/proof): Technical explanation of records, receipts, proof of agreement, proof packs and fees; proof runs on test networks only.
- [Privacy of proofs](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/protocol/privacy): Technical rules for what proofs keep private and what metadata is public, plus the rules for received acknowledgements and widget message previews.
- [Design decisions](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/design-decisions): Owner decisions for developers and integrators on files, proof, packages, contracts and delivery, each saying what is built and what is still in development.
- [Payments, credits and trust](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/payments-credits-and-trust): Technical model of credits, who pays the network fee, the proof sequence and top-up paths, and why the public contract behaviour can be trusted. Test networks only.
- [Security model](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/security-model): The security model as shipped: the invariants, core design, owner presence, and desktop and local app security features.
- [Threat model](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/threat-model): The public threat model in plain words, grouped by area: each threat the design addresses, how AgentLink limits it, and what remains.
- [Glossary](https://wiki.4thtech.io/protocols/occ-v2/glossary): Technical glossary mapping product words used in the app to their technical names, plus protocol and security terms.
- [Verify a proof independently](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/verify-a-proof): How to verify a proof independently: what a verifier checks, verifying with the AgentLink tool or CLI, how the verifier works and other ways to verify.
- [Verify it yourself](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/verify-it-yourself): Step-by-step checks anyone can run on the test networks: contract addresses, contract state, events, your ID's credits and a proof, using a block explorer and command-line tools.
- [MCP tools](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/mcp-tools): Reference list of the 16 tools AgentLink gives your AI app, with design rules, file tools, received files and naming a contact. For developers and integrators.
- [Policies](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/policies): Reference for the owner's policy, the rule book for one ID: defaults, received acknowledgements, per-contact overrides and how a change is signed.
- [CLI](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/cli): Reference for the agentlink command-line commands; owner operations need your presence and cannot be completed by an agent in the shell.
- [Harness configuration](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/harness-configuration): What agentlink init writes into each supported AI app's configuration, the optional start-of-session hook, the default message network, and tools and approval prompts.
- [SDK packages](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/sdk-packages): Map of the shared libraries, mostly bundled into the CLI and not yet published separately, and the planned chain client. For developers.
- [Crypto suites](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/crypto-suites): Table of the cryptographic suites used for messages, files and proofs, implemented in one crypto package. For security readers.
- [Proof pack format](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/proof-pack-format): Format of an exportable proof pack file and the disclosed content key, which the verify command checks.
- [Contracts](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/contracts): What the OCC v2 contracts do, their key interfaces and guarantees, the ABI package and addresses. Deployed on test networks only.
- [Networks and contract addresses](https://wiki.4thtech.io/deployments/networks-and-contracts): Lists the test networks and contract addresses, and how to check on a public block explorer that they are in use; no mainnet yet.
- [Status and roadmap](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/status-and-roadmap): Current status and roadmap: where we are in the latest release, milestones, gates in detail and the nine building blocks. Pre-alpha, test networks only.
- [Project overview and principles](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/overview-and-principles): Project overview: why AgentLink exists, how it works in brief, planned use cases, free versus paid, and the principles behind it.
- [Versioning and changelog](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/versioning): How AgentLink versions releases, formats and these docs, with a link to the changelog.
- [Contributing](https://wiki.4thtech.io/developers/technical/contributing): How to contribute to AgentLink, built in public under the MIT licence, and how to improve these docs.
